industry_specific_challenges: Admin time eating into coaching time
Demonstrating ROI to justify premium pricing

pain_points.name: Admin Time vs Coaching Time
pain_points.description: Scheduling, notes, billing, and follow-ups consume significant time
pain_points.impact: 30-50% of time spent on admin instead of billable coaching
pain_points.ai_potential: Automation + AI can reclaim 10+ hours/week for coaching or personal time

pain_points.name: Session Documentation Burden
pain_points.description: Taking notes during/after sessions takes time and impacts presence
pain_points.ai_potential: AI transcription + summaries save 75%+ of documentation time

pain_points.name: Income Ceiling in 1:1 Model
pain_points.description: Limited hours means limited income without burning out
pain_points.impact: Income capped at hours available × rate
pain_points.ai_potential: Automation enables group programs and courses that scale beyond 1:1

pain_points.name: Maintaining Client Momentum Between Sessions
pain_points.description: Clients lose focus between sessions without accountability
pain_points.impact: Lower results, lower retention, fewer referrals
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated personalized check-ins keep clients engaged between sessions

key_metrics.name: Lifetime Client Value
key_metrics.description: Total revenue from average client relationship
key_metrics.benchmark: €5,000-25,000 for executive coaching, €1,000-5,000 for life coaching
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Package structures, retention programs, upsells to group programs

key_metrics.name: Client Retention/Re-engagement Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of clients who renew or re-engage
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Progress tracking, accountability check-ins, results documentation

key_metrics.name: Referral Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of new clients from referrals
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Testimonial collection, referral programs, results documentation

key_metrics.name: Weekly Coaching Hours
key_metrics.description: Hours spent in actual coaching sessions vs admin
key_metrics.benchmark: 20-25 hours coaching is sustainable, 15-20 optimal for quality
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Automation of scheduling, notes, and admin tasks

key_metrics.name: Session Show Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of scheduled sessions that happen
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Automated reminders, calendar sync, cancellation policies
